```python
def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Convert text to a URL-safe slug."""
    # Lowercase everything
    text = text.lower()
    # Remove punctuation and convert spaces to dashes
    return "".join(
        ["-" if c.isspace() else c if c.isalnum() else "" for c in text]
    )
```
